newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise February rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise February rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Tuesday that it would raise the margin requirement on its February rubber futures contract by 50,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Wednesday.
The hike will bring the total February requirement to 127,750 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
The increase is intended to cool overheated trade.
The requirement on other rubber contracts will be unchanged at 52,500 yen, TOCOM said.
